name: Absolute
desc: Outputs the absolute value of the input signal.

name: Accelerometer
desc: Measures acceleration in m/s².

name: Accumulator
desc: Adds the input value to its internal total and outputs the result. Can be reset to 0 via the Reset port in Continuous mode (resets while signal ≥ 0.5) or Pulse mode (resets only when the signal crosses ≥ 0.5)
ports: Value added to the internal total.
Resets the total to 0 (Continuous or Pulse mode).

name: Arc Cosine
desc: Outputs the arc cosine (inverse cosine) of the input value in radians.

name: Hyperbolic Arc Cosine
desc: Outputs the hyperbolic arc cosine of the input value.

X = A + B

Input data for A.
X = **A** + B

Input data for B.
X = A + **B**

Outputs data for X.
**X** = A + B

name: Addition Array
desc: Outputs the sum of all connected inputs.

name: Aerometer
desc: Measures the current aerodynamics of the spaceship. Higher means better.
ports: Outputs the current aerodynamics of the spaceship in range from 0 (worst) to 1 (best).

name: Altimeter
desc: Measures height above sea level. Outputs INF when outside any atmosphere. For proper functioning, it must be mounted outside the ship with an unobstructed view.
ports: Outputs the _height above sea level_ in meters.

name: Angry Box
desc: A strange box containing something very angry from Aundara’s ocean.

name: Arc-270 Meter
desc: Displays the data signal from the input port.
ports: Input signal to be shown on the display.

name: Arc-90 Meter
desc: Displays the data signal from the input port.
ports: Input signal to be shown on the display.

name: Arc Sine
desc: Outputs the arc sine (inverse sine) of the input value in radians.

name: Hyperbolic Arc Sine
desc: Outputs the hyperbolic arc sine of the input value.

name: Arc Tangent 2
desc: Outputs the angle in radians between the positive x-axis and the point (y, x).

name: Arc Tangent
desc: Outputs the arc tangent (inverse tangent) of the input value in radians.

name: Hyperbolic Arc Tangent
desc: Outputs the hyperbolic arc tangent of the input value.

name: Atmometer
desc: Measures current atmosphere density. For proper functioning it must be mounted outside the ship with an unobstructed view.
ports: Outputs the _atmosphere density_ in range from 0 to 1.

name: Atmospheric Fan
desc: Provides the thrust required to move the spaceship. Its efficiency depends on atmospheric density, meaning it won't function in space, but works underwater (up to 5000m below sea level). Ideal for intraplanetary flights. Works in two directions - forward and backward. Requires electrical power to operate properly.
ports: The input signal ranges from -1 (full reverse), through 0 (stop), to 1 (full forward), and controls the _speed_.

name: Atmospheric Flat Fan
desc: Provides the thrust required to move the spaceship. Its efficiency depends on atmospheric density, meaning it won't function in space, but works underwater (up to 5000m below sea level). Ideal for takeoff and landing. Requires electrical power to operate properly.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

name: Atmospheric Thruster
desc: Provides the thrust required to move the spaceship. Its efficiency depends on atmospheric density, meaning it won't function in space. Does not work underwater. Ideal for intraplanetary flights. Requires electrical power to operate properly.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

name: Auto-Hemisphere Solar Panel
desc: A hemispherical panel that automatically pivots to face the brightest light source and converts sunlight into electrical power. Efficiency is highest when the panel is perfectly aligned, and power output falls off as the angle between the panel and the light increases. Any object blocking its “sun zone” will also reduce its efficiency.

name: Axis Rotometer
desc: Measures the current angular velocity (degrees per second) about its mounted axis.
ports: Outputs the current angular velocity in degrees per second.

name: Ballast
desc: Ballast is used to regulate buoyancy using electrical power, allowing a vessel to sink, hover, or rise when underwater.
ports: Input value in range from 0 (no buoyancy) to 1 (max buoyancy).

name: Baobara Interferencemeter
desc: Electronic equipment used to locate the source of interference on Baobara. Displays the distance to the interference source.

name: Beeper
desc: Generates a beep sound whose period varies with the input data signal and includes a knob to adjust the volume.
ports: Input signal from 0 (mute) to 1 (static beep), with beep period increasing with the value.

name: Bidirectional Maneuvering Thruster
desc: Provides thrust to rotate the spaceship. It doesn't have a gimbal, so all the power is used for rotation. Works bi-directional. Requires electrical power to function properly.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (backwards) to 1 (forwards) to control _speed_.

name: Blue Tank
desc: Blue alone is providing very small amount of effectivity with no reactivity. Appears as a blue-colored gas.

name: C4 Bomb
desc: C4 Bomb that detonates at input signal ≥ 0.5.

name: Braking Point System (BPS)
desc: Uses current distance, speed, and acceleration to estimate the stopping distance. Results appear on a color scale - red means you’re at risk of collision, green means you have a safe stopping margin. While it’s actively computing and operational, the green light blinks.
ports: Input for _distance_ to planet in meters.
Outputs the indicator position from -1 (left/red), through 0 (center/white), to 1 (right/green).

name: Button
desc: Outputs a data signal of 1 while held down and 0 when released.
ports: Outputs 1 when pressed, 0 when not pressed.

name: Camera Overlay
desc: Can be used for displaying values and text on monitor screens.

name: Camera
desc: Outputs a live video to the output port. Requires electrical power to operate.

name: Candy Bouquet
desc: Mysterious flowers from the depths of Basalt’s canyons.

name: Clima Bomb
desc: Clima Bomb used to restore the Moon’s natural atmosphere. Detonate at an altitude of 1500 - 1600 meters above sea level.
ports: Input a value ≥ 0.5 to decouple from your spaceship. Detonation will occur 5 seconds after separation.

name: Colored Light Controller

Data input value for the _green_ channel, ranging from 0 to 1.
Data input value for the _blue_ channel, ranging from 0 to 1.

name: Colored Light
desc: Colored light with adjustable intensity and color settings. Can be paired wirelessly with the Colored Light Controller.

name: Condition
desc: Performs the selected comparison on two inputs. If the condition is true, outputs the value from the True port, otherwise, outputs the value from the False port.
ports: True input port. If unconnected, defaults to 1.
False input port. If unconnected, defaults to 0.
Outputs the value chosen by the condition - either the True value or the False value.

name: Constant

name: Cosine
desc: Outputs the cosine of the input angle in radians.

name: Hyperbolic Cosine

name: Damaged Large Fuel Thruster

name: Data Cable
desc: Connects two data ports. Can only be connected to yellow (input) or blue (output) ports.

name: Data Hub
desc: Routes the signal from one of five input ports to the output port, determined by the currently pressed channel button.
ports: Outputs one of five input signals determined by pressed channel button.

name: Datameter
desc: Displays the data signal from the input port.
ports: Input signal to be shown on the display.
Outputs the signal from the input port.

name: Decoupler Small
desc: Holds components on the suction side. For instant release send a data signal of 0.5 or higher to the input port.
ports: Input a value of 0.5 or higher to break suction.

name: Delay
desc: Delays the input signal by a configurable amount from 1 to 60 ticks.

name: Differentiator
desc: Measures how much a signal changes over a selected time interval. It compares the current value to an earlier value and outputs the difference.
ports: Change in the signal over the selected time interval (current value minus earlier value).

name: Distance Meter
desc: Measures distance to the nearest object up to 1000 meters and outputs the value to the data port.
ports: Outputs _distance to nearest object_ in meters (up to 1000 meters).

name: Divider

Input data for A.

name: Drum Kit
desc: Space is silent. Your ship doesn't have to be.

name: Ducted Fan
desc: Provides powerful thrust to move the spaceship. The fan can be tilted forwards and backwards to adjust the flight direction. The thruster's efficiency depends on atmospheric density, meaning it doesn't work in space and has minimal performance underwater. Ideal for intraplanetary flights. Requires a significant amount of electrical power to operate properly.

Input data signal to control _fan rotation_: -1 (full reverse), 0 (upwards), 1 (full forward).

name: Dynamo Box

name: ETA System

ports: Input for _distance_ to planet in meters.

name: Electric Flat Thruster
desc: Provides the thrust required to move the spaceship. Ideal for takeoff and landing. Requires electrical power to operate properly.

name: Exponential

name: Fader

Outputs input signal multiplied by fader.

name: Floodlight

Input data signal from 0 to 1 to control _horizontal rotation_.
Input data signal from -1 to 1 to control _vertical rotation_.

desc: Outputs the first input raised to the power of the second input.

name: Power Blocker
desc: Blocks electric power between two power ports if receiving data signal in input port higher or equal to 0.5.
ports: Input data signal of 0.5 or higher to block power between the two power ports.

name: Power Cable
desc: Used to connect multiple electrical components together. Can only be connected to red-colored electric ports.

name: Power Generation Meter
desc: Displays the current power generation per second in the connected electric circuit and outputs the value to the output port. The light on the indicator shows green when there is enough power in the circuit and red when there is a power deficiency.
ports: Outputs power generation in P/s of the connected electric circuit.

name: Power Nanocable
desc: Advanced power cable. Used to connect multiple electrical components together. Can only be connected to red-colored electric ports.

name: Power Router
desc: Serves as a hub for connecting multiple power cables into same electric circuit.

name: Power Usage Meter
desc: Displays the current power usage per second in the connected electric circuit and outputs the value to the output port. The light on the indicator shows green when there is enough power in the circuit and red when there is a power deficiency.
ports: Outputs power usage in P/s of the connected electric circuit.

name: Radar
desc:
Used to locate planetary stations and analyze terrain elevation, helping you identify flat surfaces for safe landings. The display automatically rotates to match the spaceship’s orientation. Requires electrical power to operate.
Select **Mode: Wall** when mounted on a wall or **Mode: Floor** when mounted on the floor.

name: Red Alert Light
desc: Provides flickering red light with alarm sound when receiving data signal 0.5 or higher on input port.
ports: Input signal of 0.5 or higher to turn on the light.

name: Red Tank
desc: A highly efficient but very reactive fuel that must be carefully mixed with other fuels and kept under active cooling. The cooler needs a continuous power supply - if power is lost while fuel remains in the tank, it may explode. When properly mixed and cooled, red fuel delivers the best performance.
ports: Outputs the _cooling state_: 1 is normal, 0 indicates imminent failure.

name: Remapper
desc: Linearly remaps a value from a given input range to a corresponding value in the output range.
ports: Input data signal to be remapped.

name: Rimcore Turbopump
desc: Gas pump and tank used to collect gases from the core of Rimshell.

name: Rotational Telescopic Camera
desc: Rotational telescopic camera operating within a hemisphere. Can rotate in three axes and zoom up to 60x. Require electrical power to function properly.
ports: Input data signal from 0 to 1 to control _horizontal rotation_.
Input data signal from -1 to 1 to control _vertical rotation_.
Input data signal from 0 to 1 to control _roll rotation_.
Input data signal from 0 to 1 to control _camera zoom_.

name: Rotometer
desc: Measures the current rotation in degrees per second.
ports: Outputs the current rotation in degrees per second.

name: Round
desc: Rounds the input value based on the selected mode: Round to the nearest integer, Floor to the nearest lower integer, or Ceil to the nearest higher integer.

ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

name: Small Fuel Thruster
desc: Provides the thrust required to move the spaceship. Suitable for long-range flights. If there isn't enough fuel, the thruster's efficiency is reduced, and the amount of thrust depends on the performance of the provided fuel.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

name: Small Gate
desc: A structural frame with a built-in electric gate used for entering and exiting the spaceship. The data signal on the input port controls the door. Requires electrical power to move the door and only consumes electricity when the door is in motion.
ports: Input data from 0 to 1 to control the gate state.
Requires {0} P/s to open or close the gate.

name: Small Knob
desc: Small knob that outputs signal from 0 to 1.
ports: Outputs signal in the range from 0 to 1.

name: Small Maneuvering Thruster
desc: Provides thrust to rotate the spaceship. It doesn't have a gimbal, so all the power is used for rotation. Requires electrical power to function properly.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

name: Small Nanogate
desc: A structural frame with a built-in electric gate used for entering and exiting the spaceship. The data signal on the input port controls the door. Requires electrical power to move the door and only consumes electricity when the door is in motion.
ports: Input data from 0 to 1 to control the gate state.

desc: Converts electric energy into plasma.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (off) to 1 (max) to control _speed_.

ports: Provides the available power and can be used to recharge the battery.

name: Small Solid Fuel Thruster
desc: Single-use thruster providing a lot of thrust for certain amount of time. For ignition it needs to be supplied with very large amount of electric power for small time period. After ignition it no longer requires any electric power and cannot be stopped.

name: Small Switch
desc: Outputs a data signal of 1 when the switch is in position 'I' and a data signal of 0 when the switch is in position 'O'.

name: Small Toggleable Light
desc: Small toggleable light providing light when turned on.

name: Solar Panel
desc: Generates electric power when facing a light source. Efficiency decreases as the facing angle increases. Obstacles in front of the solar zone reduce efficiency.

name: Solar Shield Generator
desc: Converts plasma into solar shield.
ports: Input data in meters to control shield radius.
Outputs the maximum amount of heat absorbed by the shield.

name: Space GPS
desc: Used to determine world-space coordinates as distance, longitude, and latitude relative to the center of the universe (the Sun). **Make sure at least 60% of the space around it is clear so it can work properly! The indicator shows signal quality: green = above 60%, red = below 60%.**

name: Space Scanner
desc: A satellite module for detecting celestial bodies in deep space. It uses a configurable scanning cone to identify planets and large objects, outputting the distance to the nearest detected object. For proper functioning, there must be no obstacles in front of the component.
ports: Input data signal from 0 (50 degrees) to 1 (1 degrees) to control _cone angle_.
Outputs the _distance to the closest object_ in the front cone of the satellite, in meters.

name: Square Root

name: Stick Switch
desc: Outputs a data signal of 1 when the switch is up and a data signal of 0 when the switch is down.
